name: flareswap
description: Cross-chain intent-based DEX on Flare — FTSO + FDC + FAssets

scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.test: npm run test:contracts && npm run test:backend
scripts.build: npm run build:contracts && npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.typecheck: cd backend && npm run typecheck && cd ../frontend && npm run typecheck
scripts.deploy:local: cd contracts && forge script script/DeployLocal.s.sol:DeployLocal --rpc-url http://127.0.0.1:8545 --broadcast --slow && ./script/export-abis.sh
scripts.deploy:coston2: cd contracts && forge script script/Deploy.s.sol:Deploy --rpc-url coston2 --broadcast --slow -vvv && ./script/export-abis.sh
scripts.seed:coston2: cd contracts && forge script script/Seed.s.sol:Seed --rpc-url coston2 --broadcast --slow -vvv
